# Landingsite

> Landingsite builds, edits and publishes websites for small businesses, and holds their leads, orders, customers and invoices. An AI assistant can do all of this for its user through Landingsite's MCP server.

## Connect an assistant

- [Setup guide for AI assistants](https://www.landingsite.ai/install.md): connect a user's Landingsite account through the MCP server at https://mcp.landingsite.ai/mcp (OAuth, no API key).
- [Connect your AI assistant](https://www.landingsite.ai/mcp): one-click setup for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and any other app that supports MCP.
- [Connect your AI assistant (docs)](https://docs.landingsite.ai/features/connect-your-ai-assistant/): the same steps, for people.

## Documentation

- [Landingsite docs](https://docs.landingsite.ai/)
- [Pricing](https://www.landingsite.ai/pricing)
